Built with advanced tall tubular technology, it offers superior durability and longer service life compared to conventional batteries. The battery is designed for easy installation and minimal maintenance, making it a practical choice for everyday use. Backed by a comprehensive 48-month warranty, you can trust in its quality and dependability. The sturdy construction and efficient design make it suitable for various inverter systems, providing consistent performance even under demanding conditions. Whether you need backup power for lighting, fans, computers, or other essential equipment, this inverter battery delivers the capacity and reliability you require. Manufactured by Luminous Power Technologies, a trusted name in power solutions, this battery combines innovative engineering with practical functionality to meet your power backup needs effectively.
